title: Design: picking another matrix on a category's page
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new category for this test, category A, on the General Matrix.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A, pricing two new categories made for this test, so it is shared.
  • Use a desktop browser window exactly 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so the screen matches the design pictures' size.
custom_steps:
1. Open Settings › Categories.
  2. Click category A's row.
  3. Pick matrix A in the Pricing Matrix picker.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Categories list shows.

Step 2:

  • Category A's page shows the Pricing Matrix picker with an info icon beside it.

Step 3:

  • A white message at the bottom right reads category A's name "now uses" matrix A's name, with "Parts already on work orders keep their prices." under it.
  • Matrix A's name labels the grid; Edit is grayed and a blue "Go to the" link names matrix A, as in picture 8.1.
